name: Indefinite Period Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least 10 years (120 months) of legal residence in Aruba on a temporary residence permit or declaration.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 120 months of legal residence on renewable temporary permits.

requirements.blocker_text: No single temporary residence permit in the qualifying history may exceed 3 years.
No gap in residence may exceed 2 years, unless justified by health or study reasons.
Must be registered in the population register at the time of application.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old (minors may be issued the permit without work authorisation).

evidence_required.document: All previous residence permits/declarations and payment certificates

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: no gap in residence exceeding 2 years without a health or study justification

sources.title: DIMAS, Government of Aruba -- Stay for an Indefinite Period: 120-month (10-year) residence requirement, 3-year cap per temporary permit, 2-year maximum continuity gap, population-register requirement, adult work rights

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Aruba's initial build -- Aruba's PR-equivalent 'settled' status. This is a materially longer road than most non-BOT, non-Kingdom countries' PR routes built this session (120 months vs. the more common 48-96), and notably longer than Curacao's equivalent 10-year permanent-residence rule -- consistent with it, in fact (both Kingdom constituent countries independently converge on 10 years). citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the separate Kingdom-level naturalisation clock in aw_naturalisation.json (5 years as a Kingdom national with a valid residence permit) rather than a citizenship rule specific to this route -- indefinite residence is not itself a precondition for naturalisation under the IND's general rule, but is the most natural on-ramp into holding a 'valid residence permit' for the full 5 years. prerequisites lists the temporary routes most likely to feed into the 120-month clock; minimum_months_held is set to 120 to reflect the accumulated-history requirement rather than a single prior route's duration.
